method: Inspected changed source and relevant surrounding authority/lifecycle paths; no production edits and no duplicated Windows, Go, or MCP suites.

windows.concreteFinding: Fixed vertical layout let the connection roster collapse or overlap the footer in a short or high-DPI work area.
windows.resolution: Owning agent replaced that layout with native vertical scrolling, minimum logical content height, shared control offsets and focus reveal. Reviewed Win32 calls occur outside RefCell borrows.
finalDeltaReviewed: active task map capacity is checked before roster reservation
unverified native teardown immediately sets restart-required and cancels parent
unacknowledged remote end cancels activation and preserves a fixed visible reason
all children are canceled before a shared bounded cleanup deadline
new offer clears answer generation; connected count requires fresh media and current acknowledged generation
orphan cleanup is owner authenticated, at most 16 entries and 15 seconds, only on 409 host_busy, cancellation aware, with one activation retry

areasReviewed: atomic four-session admission including pending slots
single input reservation and no spectator permission upgrade
activation replacement, stop and host recovery revoke all related sessions and signals
KDF unlock/revalidation, shared failure ledger and generic unavailable responses
stable display ID across recovery/restart without persisted activation authority
fixed validated HTTPS service origin and browser method allowlist
PIN clearing, debug logging refusal, and safe public errors
generation/cancellation guards, bounded serial queue and late adapter disposal
single-use screenshot token age, target and coordinate binding
current permission and production web media/display/session checks
local revoke before awaited server end and release-all after input

limits: Source review is not native execution.
Native Windows tray/DPI/Explorer/lifecycle and real media/input behavior were not executed by this reviewer.
Chromium launch is blocked by recorded EPERM before page creation; no real browser or WebRTC session claimed.
Snapshots identify reviewed bytes; later source changes require the owning agent to assess their effect.
